methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

actual_scope: Accelerate the exact equality engine inside the complete retained PR3202 two-provider native-slice audit, using independently implemented signed Pauli action plus an exact anchor vector; compare the original and existing table-cached kernels on identical circuits.
scope_change_reason: The runtime card is narrowed to the current R2 native equality stage. The established Clifford criterion and the existing producer are credited; no new semantic admission coverage is claimed.
bottleneck_link: Independent native audits execute hundreds to thousands of complete phase-sensitive Clifford comparisons. A sound faster comparator makes those audits and negative controls cheaper while leaving their source/event/ownership boundaries explicit.
stop_rule: Session 2026-10-17T17:39Z to 18:39Z; stop if full equality or meaningful measured wall-time gain fails. Reserve at least the final 15 minutes for verification and handoff. Benchmark only the existing retained two-provider slice; do not expand its missing cleanup or supplier obligations.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the complete comparator criterion and literal gate rules. BENCHMARK.json records nine fresh serial runs over the same 253 comparisons and unchanged complete result. RESULT.json records exact input hashes, decisions and independent full-matrix controls.
author: Tekalign (@tekuuu)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof adaptation, independent comparator code, source integration, tests, measurements and writing. The criterion is predecessor mathematics; no independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed.
